title: Ad deam qui laetificat juventutem meam.
html_source:
‘to the goddess , who giveth joy to my youth’.

Echoes the words of a minister at mass -‘to God who has gladdened the days of my youth’ in response to the celebrant at the beginning of mass (Gifford & Seidman, p454).
